path_raid.title: Ash Along the Veins
path_raid.prompt: The ash moves along the old veins. Watchers call for orders. The Bound on the lines wait on your will.

options.label: Hold the Watch
options.tip: Commit defense strength. Safer for those who walk; the circle steadies.

effects.log: You hold the watch. Eyes on the ash; the Bound feel the circle with them.

options.label: Pull Them Back
options.tip: Spend shards to pull walkers to shelter. Costly; lives kept.

effects.log: You pull them back to the circle. Shards burn so the Bound may stay.

options.label: Strike the Ash
options.tip: Retaliate. Risk more losses; seize shards and harden the will.

effects.log: You strike the ash. The veins answer in kind. Something in the Bound goes quieter.

options.label: Abandon the Line
options.tip: Let the vein take them. Preserve the hearth; the ash remembers the cost.

effects.log: You abandon the line. The hearth holds. Not all who walked return.
